facts.fact: 她怕自己半夜醒不来，索性不睡，把能活动开的衣服全穿好，躺下干等
facts.anchor: I’m afraid I won’t be able to wake up on time

facts.fact: 她身上那件深红 T 恤是 Mender 亲手染的
facts.anchor: my deep red T-shirt, dyed by the Mender himself

facts.fact: 这几个月学到的事在她脑子里打转，像雨水灌进下水道
facts.anchor: Everything I’ve learned over the past few months swirls in my mind like rainwater going down a storm drain.

facts.fact: 她过去信父亲那套：Abnegation 在顶端，是因为他们把自己放到最底下
facts.anchor: Abnegation at the top because they’re determined to put themselves at the bottom

facts.fact: 差十分三点，她摸黑穿过博物馆主厅
facts.anchor: At ten minutes to three, I creep across the main hall of the Museum.
